title: Updating the marked-code count
statement: For any machine state $st$ and natural number $k$, replacing coordinate $15$ of its register vector by $k$ yields the register vector of the state obtained from $st$ by setting its marked-code count $c$ to $k$.
replaced:
For any state and any natural number $k$, replacing the sixteenth coordinate of its
$17$-component register vector by $k$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by
setting its marked-code count $c$ to $k$.
